resolution.note: parseTickets in src/repo/protocol-lines.ts replaces four readers; round-trip tests per form

title: One Ticket and Refs trailer parser reads comma lists for every reader
body:
Evidence: 2026-11-20 krn lane finish hooks-pretool exit 64: HEAD trailer 'Refs: t-w2bsagz, t-1kn5yb8' was read as naming no task; ADR 0028 'Protocol lines' records that Ticket/Refs comma lists are parsed differently by lane run, task-merge and CI.
Outcome: one parseTickets(message) in src/repo/protocol-lines.ts (ADR 0028 step 6) returns every id of a comma-list Ticket or Refs trailer, and lane finish, lane run, task-merge and branch-tickets use it.
Proof: a round-trip test of format/parse for single, comma-list and paragraph trailers; lane finish on a branch whose HEAD carries 'Refs: t-a, t-b' resolves the claimed task.
Files: src/repo/protocol-lines.ts, src/cli/lane-finish.ts, test/repo/
